requirement.functional.name: accessControl
requirement.functional.@statement: Who may do what is answered from stored grants, never from a name compared to a literal in code

requirement.functional.name: grants
requirement.functional.@counterexample: A grant that cannot say where it applies
requirement.functional.@statement: A role is granted to a user either system-wide or within one group

requirement.functional.name: scopedGrantRequiresMembership
requirement.functional.@counterexample: A scoped grant naming a user who never joined the group
requirement.functional.@notes: The schema cannot express it; enforced in the service layer.
requirement.functional.@statement: A role granted within a group is held only by a member of that group
